checks.label: The Delivery driver is driving
The Delivery vehicle belongs to the Delivery driver
The Delivery driver and Delivery vehicle are on the same route
The Delivery driver is ready to drive
The Delivery vehicle is operational

limits: The action starts one represented ten-mile driving attempt without checking whether enough fuel remains.
Neither road position advances when the attempt starts; autonomous vehicle processes determine whether the vehicle advances or stops.
The driver is treated as accompanying the owned vehicle, so the driver's stored road position is not updated.
Traffic, road closure, breakdown, reverse travel, and delivery unloading are not modeled.
mechanics.rationale: Starting a ten-mile driving attempt marks the vehicle as attempting to drive without claiming that it has begun moving; autonomous processes then resolve fuel availability.
semantic_bindings: components.vehicle.operational_status equal to attempting to drive represents an unresolved driving attempt, not vehicle motion.
components.vehicle.road_position records completed vehicle progress along the route.
The drive action does not inspect or consume components.vehicle.fuel.
Autonomous vehicle processes determine whether the vehicle advances or stops for insufficient fuel.
The selected Delivery driver is treated as accompanying the owned Delivery vehicle without synchronizing components.driver.road_position.
tests: An operational owned Delivery vehicle can begin a driving attempt even with less than 0.4 fuel.
Beginning a driving attempt changes the Delivery vehicle status to attempting to drive without changing either road position.
With zero fuel, the stopping process changes the Delivery vehicle status from attempting to drive to stopped without advancing it.
With at least 0.4 fuel, the advancing process moves the Delivery vehicle ten miles, consumes 0.4 fuel, and restores operational status.
Driving is refused when the Delivery driver and Delivery vehicle have different route locations.
Driving is refused when the Delivery vehicle does not belong to the Delivery driver.
Driving is refused when the Delivery vehicle is not operational.

checks.label: The Delivery driver is buying the fuel
The Delivery vehicle belongs to the Delivery driver
The Delivery driver and Delivery vehicle are on the same route
The Delivery vehicle and Gas station are on the same route
The Delivery vehicle is at the Gas station
The Gas station is open
The Delivery vehicle is operational
The requested fuel amount is one unit
The Gas station has one unit of fuel
The Delivery vehicle has a sixteen-unit tank
The Delivery vehicle has room for one unit of fuel

limits: Fuel purchases are restricted to one-unit atomic transfers.
A purchase is refused above fifteen units because the full one-unit transfer would exceed the represented sixteen-unit tank.
Fractional tank headroom below one unit cannot be filled by this action.
The selected driver is treated as accompanying the owned vehicle, so the driver's stored road position is not checked.
The action does not limit purchases to the fuel needed for the remaining route.
Payment and money are omitted because no represented monetary state exists.
Refueling does not repair a non-operational vehicle.
mechanics.rationale: A one-unit fuel purchase is allowed only when the represented sixteen-unit tank has room for the entire atomic transfer.
semantic_bindings: The amount field is bound to a one-unit fuel transfer.
components.place.fuel_stock is the source stock for fuel sold by the Gas station.
components.vehicle.fuel is the receiving stock in the Delivery vehicle.
components.vehicle.fuel_tank_capacity identifies the represented sixteen-unit tank.
Fuel at or below fifteen leaves room for the complete one-unit transfer.
Equal route locations and matching vehicle and station road positions represent presence at the Gas station.
The selected Delivery driver is treated as accompanying the owned Delivery vehicle without consulting components.driver.road_position.
tests: Refueling at fifteen units raises Delivery vehicle fuel to sixteen and lowers Gas station fuel stock by one.
Refueling is refused when Delivery vehicle fuel is greater than fifteen, including at sixteen units.
Repeated refueling never raises Delivery vehicle fuel above its sixteen-unit tank capacity.
Refueling is refused when the Delivery vehicle is away from the Gas station road position.
Refueling is refused when the Gas station is not open.
Refueling is refused when the selected vehicle does not belong to the Delivery driver.
Refueling is refused when the amount is not exactly one.
Refueling is refused when Gas station fuel stock is below one.

checks.label: The Delivery driver is recording the progress
The Delivery vehicle belongs to the Delivery driver
The Delivery vehicle is on the Delivery road
The Delivery vehicle is awaiting route progress
The Delivery vehicle has completed unrecorded progress
The Delivery road has at least ten miles remaining

limits: Progress is recorded in ten-mile increments matching successful driving attempts.
A successful movement must be recorded before another driving attempt can begin.
The action does not move the Delivery vehicle or consume fuel.
Progress cannot be recorded when fewer than ten miles remain, so partial final segments are not modeled.
Road endpoints, reverse travel, and unloading at the Town are not modeled.
mechanics.rationale: Each successful ten-mile vehicle advance must be reconciled exactly once before the vehicle becomes available for another driving attempt.
semantic_bindings: components.vehicle.operational_status equal to awaiting route progress represents one successful ten-mile advance that has not yet been reconciled with the Delivery road.
components.place.road_position on the Delivery road records vehicle progress already reconciled with the route.
components.place.distance_remaining falls by ten for each reconciled ten-mile advance.
Restoring components.vehicle.operational_status to operational marks the pending movement as recorded and permits the next driving attempt.
tests: After the Delivery vehicle advances from mile 0 to mile 10, recording progress raises the Delivery road position to 10, lowers its distance remaining to 110, and restores the vehicle to operational.
A second progress recording without another successful vehicle advance is refused because the Delivery vehicle is no longer awaiting route progress.
Another driving attempt is refused while the Delivery vehicle is awaiting route progress.
After each successful advance is recorded, the next driving attempt can begin.
When the Delivery vehicle advances from mile 110 to mile 120, the required recording raises the Delivery road position to 120 and lowers its distance remaining to zero.
Progress recording is refused before the Delivery vehicle has moved beyond the Delivery road's recorded position.
Progress recording is refused when the Delivery vehicle is not on the selected Delivery road.
Progress recording is refused when the Delivery vehicle does not belong to the Delivery driver.

checks.label: The Delivery driver is requesting roadside assistance
The Delivery vehicle belongs to the Delivery driver
The Delivery driver and Delivery vehicle are on the same route
The Delivery vehicle and destination are on the same route
The Delivery vehicle is stopped
The Delivery vehicle lacks fuel for ten miles
The destination is ahead of the Delivery vehicle

limits: The action records only the driver's roadside-assistance request.
No tow provider, communication system, response time, cargo state, or payment state is represented.
The request does not move, refuel, repair, or change the status of the Delivery vehicle.
The request is refused unless the Delivery vehicle is stopped with less than 0.4 fuel.
The selected destination must be ahead on the same represented route.
mechanics.rationale: A driver whose owned vehicle has stopped without enough fuel can request roadside assistance toward a selected destination ahead, while no unrepresented towing outcome is assumed.
semantic_bindings: components.driver.decision_status equal to awaiting roadside assistance represents a submitted request with no represented response yet.
components.vehicle.operational_status equal to stopped identifies the vehicle stranded by the existing insufficient-fuel process.
Fuel below 0.4 means the Delivery vehicle cannot complete another represented ten-mile advance.
A greater destination road position represents a destination ahead of the stopped Delivery vehicle.
The absence of represented assistance or towing resources prevents this action from asserting transport to the destination.
tests: A driver can request roadside assistance when the owned Delivery vehicle is stopped with less than 0.4 fuel and the Town is ahead on the same route.
A successful request changes the Delivery driver's decision status to awaiting roadside assistance.
A successful request does not move or refuel the Delivery vehicle.
The request is refused while the Delivery vehicle is operational.
The request is refused when the Delivery vehicle has at least 0.4 fuel.
The request is refused when the Delivery vehicle does not belong to the Delivery driver.
The request is refused when the destination is not ahead of the Delivery vehicle.
The request is refused when the destination is on a different route.

checks.label: The Delivery vehicle is attempting to drive
The Delivery vehicle has enough fuel for ten miles

processes.rationale: A successful ten-mile advance leaves the vehicle awaiting route reconciliation, preventing another driving attempt before that movement is recorded.

checks.label: The Delivery vehicle is attempting to drive
The Delivery vehicle lacks fuel for ten miles

processes.rationale: A pending driving attempt stops without movement when the vehicle has less than the 0.4 fuel needed to advance ten miles.
